plan.coverage_explanation: Tests released-state silence, repeated press-to-262Hz responses, sustained presses, and repeated release-to-silence responses on the circuit-specified pins. Checks the explicitly required input and output modes.
assumptions: The supplied circuit fixes the button input at pin 3 and buzzer output at pin 9; no bench-default pin or wiring assumptions are needed.

The supplied external pull-up makes the released button HIGH and the pressed button LOW. The circuit's 1000-ohm resistor differs from the prose's 10k-ohm resistor, but both provide the specified digital polarity; the test preserves the supplied wiring.
No precise response latency is specified, so observations allow 250 ms for settling. Tone frequency is checked within 3 Hz to accommodate timer quantization.
